the development of a novel steering control system based upon the human mechanical impedance properties of the arms in steering operations.
the development of a new vehicle active steering control system based not only on the steering angle and torque but also on the HMIP properties of the arms.
the design of a vehicle active steering control system that is based on the HMIPS of the driver's arms and that provides the driver with a comfortable driving feel.

a steering control method based on the HMIPS of the arms can be used for improving the steering performance of a vehicle.
